keywords.warn.language_mismatch: Different languages: target in '{target}', reference in '{reference}'. Keywords are not meaningful.
keywords.warn.no_reference_docs: The reference has no per-item text counts: the dispersion filter applies to the target only.
keywords.warn.same_data: Target and reference are the same documents.
keywords.warn.small_reference: Small reference ({words} words): prefer a reference larger than the target.
keywords.warn.small_target: Small target ({words} words): results are unstable. Prefer corpora with at least {minimum} words.
keywords.warn.tokenizer_mismatch: Different tokenisation ({target} × {reference}): contractions and hyphens may be counted differently.
keywords.warn.tool_mismatch: Target tagged with {target} and reference with {reference}: lemmas and classes may not be comparable. Use forms or tag with the same tagger.
keywords.warn.tool_version_mismatch: Same tagger ({tool}) in different versions ({target} × {reference}): small differences are possible.
keywords.warn.unit_unavailable: Unit '{unit}' needs {field}, which layer {tool} lacks; items without {field} were counted by form.
lab.warn.experimental: Experimental method: exploratory result, not evidence. The API and figures may change.
lab.warn.multiple: {tests} comparisons: with this many tests some differences appear by chance. Prefer effect sizes and corrected p.
lab.warn.small_group: Groups with fewer than {n} texts ({groups}): estimates are unstable.
lab.warn.unequal: Groups of very different sizes ({min} to {max} texts): compare with care (the wkfa metric weights by size).
